description: The one canonical rsw modulus identity fixture: the shared 2048-bit modulus of both language test suites (packages/kiwicaptcha-php RswFixture::MODULUS_N_B64 and packages/kiwicaptcha rsw::fixtures::MODULUS_N_B64, the base64 of tools/rsw-keygen's FIXTURE_N_HEX) with the identity values every component must agree on. rsw_modulus_n_sha256 is the canonical identity: lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the DECODED 256-byte modulus, exactly what the rsw-keygen prints as rsw_modulus_n_sha256 (the PHP RswModulusIdentity::fingerprint, the Rust rsw::modulus_fingerprint_hex). legacy_base64_text_sha256 is the historical pre-migration PHP rule (SHA-256 of the base64 TEXT), a clearly named legacy alias accepted only for identity-bearing records below protocol v5. The fixture is asserted by the PHP RswModulusIdentityTest, the Rust rsw identity test and the rsw-keygen fixture test.

secondary.description: A second generated trapdoor pair, published here for the A-bound-record / B-configured-verifier negative tests only (an attacker-computed B proof for an A-bound record must never verify). Test material; never deploy.
